title: Notify the landlord after receiving completion information for the matching job

semantic_requirements.description: State that the contractor has reported the dishwasher work at this address complete and has sent an invoice.
Attribute the status to event 027; do not claim tenant confirmation, a deducted charge, or a paid invoice.
Do not use the amount of £162.85, which first appears in future event 028; the invoice amount may be described as awaiting verification.

prohibited_behaviors: Inventing £162.85 or any other amount that is not currently visible.
Claiming that payment has been made or deducted from rent.
Closing the case directly while ignoring the pending landlord notification.

input_evidence.excerpt:
Dear Harbour Surveying,

This is a new Dishwasher Repair Request for the property at Flat 2, 42 Beacon Close, Bellmere, ZZ4 2ZZ.

Please contact the tenant to arrange a suitable time to quote for this job.

Contact Details: 07700 900752
Tenant Name: Nora Palmer
Request description: Dishwasher starts then beeps and powers light flashes.  Just stops working. It’s  an integrated dishwasher .

We request that you arrange this appointment as soon as possible to ensure a smooth experience for our customers.

Please include in your email, along with the quote, the estimated time required to complete the work after receiving the landlord’s approval.

Please remember that along with a quotation, you must provide a photo or video (where applicable) clearly highlighting what needs to be changed and explaining why.
The customer, Langley from Harbour Surveying, sent an invoice for a completed job at Flat 2, 42 Beacon Close, Bellmere, ZZ4 2ZZ.

reference_actions.excerpt:
Address: Flat 2, 42 Beacon Close, Bellmere, ZZ4 2ZZ

Hi Clara, I hope you are well. We sent Harbour Surveying to Flat 2, 42 Beacon Close, Bellmere, ZZ4 2ZZ - They have repaired the dishwasher on site and it is all up and running. I will pass the invoice of £162.85 to come from the rent Regards,

provenance.derivation: Event 027 is the contractor sending a completed job invoice matching the case address. Historical event 028 notifies the landlord that repairs are complete. Retain that action, but exclude the £162.85 amount introduced in 028 because it is absent from the truncated input. This is an information visibility constraint, not a newly invented corrective path.
provenance.review_scope: Historical prefix events 001–027 and the reference action; later events are not inputs or required facts.

grading.action_source: Use recorded CaseState.actions or tool entries in traces, not only model statements or the status in ANSWER.md.
grading.rule: Exactly one actual tool attempt; its name and exact_arguments match an allowed branch. Sum semantic_requirements weights and normalize to a score from 0 to 4. A prohibited behavior yields 0. History is not the only acceptable answer; alternative paths may be retained for manual review.
grading.tool_error: A failed/refused tool is not successful execution. Record the failure; do not manually fix the answer.
grading.semantic_review: Assess message/argument semantics against the visible input and labels. Do not treat new facts in future reference_actions as facts already known to the agent.
